title: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK
summary_cn: 据BBC了解，苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人计划从美国搬回英国，定居伦敦以外的一处私人非皇家住所，他们的孩子将于9月入读英国学校。国王查尔斯已被告知这一决定，但两人不会恢复王室职务，仍将作为私人个体生活。
paragraphs_en: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex are set to move back to the UK after six years abroad
The Duke and Duchess of Sussex are planning to move back to the UK, the BBC understands.

As first reported by the Daily Telegraph , external and the Sun, , external Prince Harry and Meghan intend to relocate from the US later this month to a private, non-royal residence outside of London.
The couple's children, Prince Archie, seven, and Princess Lilibet, five, are enrolled to start at a British school in September.
King Charles was told of the move on Sunday. There are no current plans for either of Prince Harry or Meghan to resume their roles as working Royals.
The Sussexes and their children visited King Charles at Highgrove in July this year, but it is understood the move was not discussed.
The BBC understands the King was unaware of the move before last weekend but he welcomes the opportunity to see more of the Sussex family in a private and personal capacity.
But there will be no expected change to the official status of Prince Harry and Meghan and they will remain as private individuals.
Prince William and Princess Catherine have also been informed of their plans.
The couple's move from California comes after they left the UK and royal duties in early 2020.
Family relations had been strained since, with July's visit to the King and Queen Camilla being a key development in their relationship.
The Palace described the meeting at the King's private home in Gloucestershire as a "private family occasion".
It was the first time the King had seen his grandchildren in person in more than four years.
Prince Harry and Meghan had not been in the UK together since 2022, when they attended the funeral of Queen Elizabeth II.
Security for the couple has long been a point of tension, with the July visit being reconsidered because the Duke of Sussex's request for police protection was rejected.
Last year, Prince Harry lost a legal challenge over the levels of security he and his family are entitled to while in the UK.
The Duke had sought to overturn a decision that had downgraded his security after he stopped being a working royal and moved to the US with the Duchess.
Prince Harry had previously said that worries about safety have prevented him from coming to the UK and bring his wife and children.

paragraphs_cn: 苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人计划在海外生活六年后搬回英国。
据BBC了解，苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人计划搬回英国。
据《每日电讯报》和《太阳报》首先报道，哈里王子和梅根打算本月晚些时候从美国搬回，住在伦敦以外的一处私人非王室住所。
这对夫妇的孩子，七岁的阿奇王子和五岁的莉莉贝特公主，已报名于九月在英国学校就读。
查尔斯国王于周日得知了这一搬家计划。目前没有计划让哈里王子或梅根恢复在职王室成员的角色。
今年七月，苏塞克斯夫妇和他们的孩子曾在海格罗夫拜访了查尔斯国王，但据了解，当时并未讨论搬家事宜。
BBC了解到，国王在上周末之前并不知道这一搬家计划，但他欢迎有机会以私人和个人身份更多地见到苏塞克斯一家。
但哈里王子和梅根的官方身份预计不会改变，他们仍将是普通公民。
威廉王子和凯瑟琳王妃也已被告知他们的计划。
这对夫妇从加州搬回，是在他们于2020年初离开英国和王室职责之后。
此后家庭关系一直紧张，七月份对国王和卡米拉王后的访问是他们关系的关键进展。
白金汉宫将这次在国王位于格洛斯特郡的私人住宅的会面描述为“私人家庭场合”。
这是国王四年来第一次亲眼见到他的孙辈。
哈里王子和梅根自2022年参加伊丽莎白二世女王的葬礼以来，一直没有一起在英国出现过。
这对夫妇的安全问题长期以来一直是紧张点，七月份的访问曾因苏塞克斯公爵要求警察保护被拒绝而重新考虑。
去年，哈里王子在关于他和家人在英国期间有权获得的安全级别的法律挑战中败诉。
公爵曾试图推翻一项决定，该决定在他不再是在职王室成员并随公爵夫人移居美国后降低了他的安全级别。
哈里王子此前曾表示，对安全的担忧阻止了他带着妻子和孩子来英国。
